title: Use source and history details
summary: Source, version, time, and integrity details help you understand where a learning or financial record came from and whether it can be reproduced.

body.text: The main page explains the learner task. Publication details and the Technical record keep the exact source, version, time, and integrity facts needed for review.

items: Source identifies the owner or reviewed input behind the record.
Version and time show which exact meaning or observation applies.
Integrity codes help detect a changed record; they do not grant permission or prove that a claim is correct.

applicability.label: Learning content, evidence, Project records, market observations, simulations, and generated content
